statement: Companies don't know which framework applies to them
quote: Most mid-sized companies I work with don't know which framework applies to them, CSRD, GRI or voluntary standards.

statement: Companies collect data before knowing what is material
quote: spent six months gathering water data that wasn't material for them at all.
severity_quote: A food producer I advised last year spent six months gathering water data that wasn't material for them at all.
interpretation_note: Second-hand account from an advisor, not the company itself.

statement: Available software is priced for enterprises
quote: The software on the market is priced for enterprises.

mapping.reason: Market signal about existing tools, not a customer need.

statement: SMEs would pay for simple guidance on what to report and why
quote: I think SMEs would pay for something simple if it told them what to report and why.
followup_question: (Ask a target customer) What have you paid for help deciding what to report? How did that go?
interpretation_note: Expert hypothesis — needs validation with target customers.
